Name: Game Night - Repeatable Solarion Chronicles
Author: kcspace
Description:
[size=4][left]Sebastian now hosts regular game nights with you and Sam. Players are given a choice whether they want to participate at the start of game night.

This mod allows configuration of the length of time between game nights. Options are 1 week, 2 weeks, 1 month, 2 months, and yearly.
[size=4]To begin the events simply walk into Sebastian's room after the configured length of time has elapsed.[/size]


[size=5][b]This mod does not add any new options or outcomes in Solarion Chronicles, it only allows the player to replay the vanilla event. Must be installed prior to his 6 heart event.[/b][/size][/left][/size]

Manifest.Name: Game Night
Manifest.Description: Adds repeatable Solarion Chronicles game night events.
